answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 29379 Country: India Title: Plz can u tell me whether can i take a loan and then with that money can i go for hajj... awaiting for ur reply.. Question: asalamualaikum... plz can u tell me whether can i take a loan and then with that money can i go for hajj... awaiting for ur reply... Answer ID: 29379 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 267/D=14/k=1432) It is not lawful to take interest based debt for hajj. However, if hajj is fardh on you and you are getting interest free debt, and you are able to repay in future, then you can take the debt and go for hajj. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
